limitations: Every observed record was attempted; a contract_validated result means that its declared input shape compiled, not that a seller is honest, available, permitted by policy, or semantically correct.
Missing or empty schemas, unsupported request encodings, cross-binding constraints and regexp constraints remain explicit unsupported records. No provider-specific hand editing was used.
This is a non-transactional paginated read of a changing marketplace. Stable totals and exhausted pages do not establish a permanent universal coverage claim.
agentic.market is a distinct registry; its curated membership definition was not established, and it was not substituted for CDP curated=true.
Only two fixture provider contracts have independent request expectations; the remaining catalog has not been fixture-executed or purchased.

HTTP JSON/text and explicit scalar query/path/header/form primitives do not imply support for arbitrary multipart, binary, SSE, authentication, asynchronous jobs, variable-cost schemes, or all payment networks.
The recorded snapshot allowed 200 seconds for discovery. The CLI default time cap may stop earlier; always inspect complete and reasons.
Original request metadata and envelope constraints are validated; contradictory methods/encodings and omitted parent constraints are rejected before registration.
